reason: Museum-OWN Linked Open Data knowledge graph (TriplyDB/Virtuoso, account `the-other-interface`, dataset `knowledge-graph`, 40.3M statements, PUBLIC, no auth). SPARQL endpoint api.collectiedata.hetnieuweinstituut.nl returns schema.org VisualArtwork + RiC + CIDOC-CRM. Data model fully mapped: prefLabel(title EN+NL), schema:artform->skos:prefLabel(medium taxonomy: 'working drawings','floor plans','design drawings','cross sections','views/elevations','blueprints','sketches','perspective drawings','photos', etc.), schema:creator->schema:name(architect/firm), schema:dateCreated->cidoc:P82a(begin year), schema:associatedMedia->MediaObject->dcterms:identifier(CDN key). Images on own CDN hni-cdn.qonqord.cloud/preview/{key} verified at 1600px JPEG, full colour, unwatermarked (5+ samples: 1600x1209, 1600x1033, 1600x912, 1600x1265). ~9,445 image-bearing VisualArtworks; ~4,410 are in-scope FLAT (drawings/plans/sections/elevations/blueprints/sketches/photos), of which 470 have a NAMED architect + parseable begin-year + title + image (the named+dated quality slice we collect per min-4). 3D models/maquettes (scale models 2458, design model 671, study model 233, presentation maquette 417) excluded via artform filter. CDN cert omits intermediate (Node UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE) -> handled with a host-scoped lenient undici dispatcher for image downloads only.

exhibitions_entry.name: Nieuwe Instituut
exhibitions_entry.description: The Netherlands' national institute for architecture, design and digital culture, custodian of the National Collection for Dutch Architecture and Urban Planning — around 4.5 million documents across hundreds of architects' archives, one of the world's largest architecture collections. Housed in Jo Coenen's landmark building on Rotterdam's Museumpark, it publishes its catalogue as open linked data, including thousands of original architectural drawings, plans, sections, elevations, blueprints and photographs by figures such as Willem Marinus Dudok, Van den Broek en Bakema and J. Gratama.
exhibitions_entry.description_ko: 네덜란드 건축·디자인·디지털문화 국립기관으로, '네덜란드 건축·도시계획 국가컬렉션'을 보존한다. 수백 명의 건축가 아카이브에 걸친 약 450만 점의 자료를 소장한 세계 최대 규모의 건축 컬렉션 가운데 하나다. 로테르담 뮈세윔파르크에 자리한 요 쿠넨 설계의 건물에 있으며, 소장 카탈로그를 오픈 링크드 데이터로 공개한다. 빌럼 마리뉘스 뒤독, 판 덴 브룩 엔 바케마, J. 흐라타마 같은 건축가들이 남긴 원본 건축 드로잉·평면도·단면도·입면도·청사진·사진 수천 점이 포함된다.

notes: SPARQL paging LIMIT/OFFSET 500 (3 pages -> 1480 named+dated rows; 470 pass flat-architecture artform filter). Scope discriminator = schema:artform EN prefLabel (SCOPE_RE keeps drawings/plans/sections/elevations/blueprints/sketches/perspectives/calques/diazotypes/views/maps + photos/transparencies/reproductions; OUT_RE drops model|maquette). category bucket: photo|transparency|reproduction -> 'photograph' else 'drawing'. Drawings NEVER colour-gated (category-protected; monochrome blueprints kept). QUALITY DECISION: the broader corpus has ~4,410 in-scope flat works WITH images, but ~60% lack any individual creator and only ~490 named works carry a parseable date — authentic archival reality, not a parser bug (verified: nameless creator nodes have only schema:roleName 'architectural firm', objects don't link to a parent archive creator). Per min-4 (artist+year MUST, no placeholders) we keep the 470 named+dated slice = fully-attributed, dated, titled, 1600px. Anonymous names ('anoniem'/'anonymous', 2 distinct) filtered by ANON_RE. To scale up later (toward ~1,721 named-but-undated or ~4,410 all-flat), relax the dateCreated/creator requirement and accept null year / institutional attribution — but that trades catalogue cleanliness for volume. TLS: hni-cdn cert omits intermediate -> CDN_DISPATCHER (undici Agent rejectUnauthorized:false) scoped to image dl only; SPARQL stays strict. dimensions not modeled at object level in this graph (left ''). Output canonical file (when --full) = public/data/het-nieuwe-instituut-collection.json, COMPACT JSON.stringify, <23MB cap (470 works ~well under).
